en.name: Wonton wrappers
en.summary: A stack of wonton wrappers is fresh wheat dough dusted with starch, so it is stored exactly like fresh pasta: 1–2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 2 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). A sealed commercial pack carries its own printed date, usually longer, and that date wins.
en.pantry: Wonton wrappers are a refrigerated fresh dough and do not belong on a counter. The sheets are thin and lightly dusted, so the outer ones dry out and crack within hours of a pack being opened — long before spoilage becomes the issue, the wrappers are simply unusable. Keep the stack covered with a damp cloth while you wrap, and put the rest back in the cold rather than leaving the pack open beside you.
en.fridge: Keep the pack sealed and flat at the back of the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within 1–2 days, or by the printed date if the pack is unopened and carries a longer one. Once opened, re-wrap the remaining stack tightly in film or slide it into a sealed bag, pressing out the air — the edges are what dry first, and a dry edge will not seal around a filling. Do not store a half-used stack loose on a plate.
en.freezer: They keep 2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze the block in its original sleeve inside a bag, flat and sealed, so the sheets stay pressed together. Thaw the whole block in the fridge overnight — peeling frozen sheets apart tears them every time, and this is the mistake that ruins a pack. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the two months are a quality limit borrowed from fresh pasta. Wrapped wontons themselves freeze better than the bare wrappers do.
en.thawing: Thaw the whole sealed block overnight in the fridge, then peel the sheets apart once they are fully soft. Never thaw on the counter or in the microwave.
spoilage: Edges gone dry, hard and cracking, so they will not seal.
A sour or fermented smell when the pack is opened.
A tacky, slimy film on the sheets, or a stack fused into one block.
Any mould spot, including grey or pink patches between sheets.
tips: Keep the stack under a damp cloth while you wrap.
Re-wrap leftovers tightly and use them within a day or two.
Freeze finished wontons on a tray rather than freezing spare wrappers.
Thaw the block whole; separating frozen sheets tears them.

faq.q: How long do wonton wrappers keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or the printed date on an unopened pack if that is longer.
Yes, 2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze the block flat and sealed, and thaw it whole in the fridge.

faq.q: Why do my wrappers tear when I separate them?
faq.a: They were still part-frozen or the edges have dried. Thaw the block fully in the fridge and keep the stack under a damp cloth.

zh.name: 餛飩皮
zh.summary: 一疊餛飩皮就是撒了澱粉的新鮮小麥麵皮，所以保存方式完全比照生鮮義大利麵：4 °C 以下冷藏 1～2 天，−18 °C 冷凍 2 個月。市售密封包裝有自己印的日期，通常更長，請以那個日期為準。
zh.pantry: 餛飩皮是冷藏的新鮮麵皮，不該放在檯面上。皮又薄、粉又少，包裝一拆，最外面幾張幾個小時內就會乾裂——還輪不到談腐敗，它就已經不能用了。包的時候用濕布蓋著整疊，沒用到的就先收回冷藏，不要整包敞著放在旁邊。
zh.fridge: 維持密封、平放在冰箱內側，保持 4 °C 以下，1～2 天內用完；未開封且標示日期更長的包裝，以包裝日期為準。開封後把剩下的整疊用保鮮膜緊緊重包，或裝進密封袋壓出空氣——最先乾掉的是邊緣，而乾掉的邊緣包不住餡。不要把用剩的一疊直接放在盤子上。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下可放 2 個月。維持原本的紙套、外面套袋，平放密封冷凍，讓皮彼此貼緊。要用時整塊放冷藏隔夜解凍——硬撕冷凍的皮，每一張都會破，而那正是毀掉一包皮最常見的錯誤。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的；這兩個月是借自生鮮義大利麵的品質期限。另外，包好的餛飩本身比空的皮更適合冷凍。
zh.thawing: 整塊維持密封放冷藏隔夜解凍，等完全變軟再一張張撕開。不要放室溫，也不要微波。
spoilage: 邊緣變乾變硬、龜裂，包起來黏不住。
拆封時聞到酸味或發酵味。
皮上有黏滑的膜，或整疊黏成一塊。
出現任何霉點，包括夾層間的灰色或粉紅斑塊。
tips: 包的時候整疊用濕布蓋著。
用剩的重新包緊，一兩天內用完。
與其冷凍空皮，不如把包好的餛飩攤在盤上凍硬再裝袋。
整塊解凍；撕冷凍的皮一定會破。

faq.q: 餛飩皮冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 1～2 天；未開封包裝若印有更長的日期，以包裝為準。
可以，−18 °C 下 2 個月。平放密封冷凍，要用時整塊放冷藏解凍。

faq.q: 為什麼我撕皮的時候一直破？
faq.a: 多半是還沒完全解凍，或邊緣已經乾掉。請整塊在冷藏中完全解凍，操作時用濕布蓋著。
